summary: Fail closed when pytest cannot resolve a meaningful Git base

delivery.outcome: Stop pytest governance when no explicit, event or verified upstream Git base exists; never silently substitute HEAD and hide committed changes. Preserve valid configured/event/upstream bases and collect-only behavior. Publish standard 0.20.79 after protected merge.
nonGoals: Change event fetching, supported explicit base references, dirty-path parsing or hook activation
Grant execution, lease, terminal or merge authority from a Git reference
Add dependencies or mutate foreign/frozen target state

architecture.decision: Remove the unverified HEAD fallback from the adopted pytest lifecycle bridge. Raise its existing governance diagnostic when no configured, event or upstream base resolves. Actual disposable Git and lifecycle fixtures cover committed changes, verified equal-head upstreams and collect-only; existing integration fixture supplies its explicitly known base. Portable runtime runs the actual bridge regression on Windows.
interfaceChanges: An unresolved Git base raises the existing GovernanceGateError before product tests instead of silently omitting committed changes.
architecture.rollback: Revert through protected publication; preserve independent controller and merge receipts.

validation.evidence: Actual missing-base and lifecycle regressions fail against the old bridge, then pass while valid base sources and collect-only remain supported.
Existing integration, full native, installed-package parity and current-head Linux/Windows/OneDev checks pass before independent review.
Independent protected merge and Goal-managed v0.20.79 publication verified.
